meta.name: Who Killed Sara
meta.description:
Hell-bent on exacting revenge and proving he was framed for his sister's murder, Álex sets out to unearth much more than the crime's real culprit.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 24 Mar 2021 · Mexico · Language: Spanish · 40 min

Not complete. On your server: S1 9/10 (missing E8) | S2 8/8 | S3 7/7

On your server — Audio: Spanish, Hindi, English (from file names)

videos.title: It Wasn't a Mistake
videos.overview: Álex makes his first move on the Lazcano family at Rodolfo's CEO appointment ceremony. Someone identifying as Diana the Huntress offers to help him.

videos.title: Bad People
videos.overview: César refuses to tell Elisa what happened to Sara 18 years ago, so she turns to Álex for answers. Chema and Lorenzo start looking for surrogates.

videos.title: Love, Sara
videos.overview: Mariana receives a chilling reminder of the crime in the mail. A flashback reveals Sara knew Chema's secret. Elisa breaks into Álex's house.

videos.title: The Monster in the Family
videos.overview: Rodolfo pays a visit to Álex and learns a shocking detail about Sara's death. Elisa wants Álex to trust her but first she must pass a test.

videos.title: Life Insurance
videos.overview: The burden of having to keep all the Lazcano secrets starts taking a toll on Elroy. Elisa and Álex attend a masquerade party at the casino.

videos.title: Hunting
videos.overview: After César's darker side is brutally exposed at the masquerade, the Lazcano siblings' loyalty begins to shift. Elroy's troubled past is disclosed.

videos.title: Fear and Guilt
videos.overview: Álex and the Lazcano siblings go to the family estate. César's casino empire starts to crumble as the events at the masquerade go public.

videos.title: Watch the World Burn
videos.overview: Álex and Rodolfo delve into the past to discover the identity of Diana the Huntress. Elisa helps Bruno figure out what happened to Emara.

videos.title: Two Graves
videos.overview: Flashbacks unravel that fateful day in 2001. Although Sara's diary seems to hold the key to her murder, a secret hidden in a wall tells another story.

videos.title: The Two Faces of Sara
videos.overview: The corpse found in the backyard threatens to put Álex back in jail. To prove his innocence, he looks for answers with a psychiatrist who treated Sara.

videos.title: Blood on Their Hands
videos.overview: Lorenzo agrees to be Álex's lawyer. Mariana decides what to do with Elroy. Elisa becomes collateral damage in one of Álex's attacks against César.

videos.title: Collapse
videos.overview: Álex’s obsession with revenge prompts Elisa to make a choice. Moncho breaks into Chema and Lorenzo's house. Sara learns a shocking truth about herself.

videos.title: It's All on You
videos.overview: Six months later, Álex discovers the identity of the corpse in his backyard. Meanwhile, César has disappeared and Elisa comes back from Europe.

videos.title: The Dead Speak
videos.overview: Álex helps Lorenzo and Chema with the aftermath of what happened at their house. Sergio targets Elisa to hurt César. Nicandro meets up with Marifer.

videos.title: This Is Personal
videos.overview: An officer shows up at Lorenzo's office to inquire about Moncho. Marifer discloses her plan to find her mom to Nicandro. Álex focuses on finding Elisa.

videos.title: We Were Never Friends
videos.overview: Flashbacks reveal Sara and Marifer's connection. Moncho's brother exacts his revenge. Nicandro hands Álex the ultimate proof of Sara's double life.

videos.title: I Killed Sara
videos.overview: A videotape hidden in Sara's closet becomes a key piece of evidence that makes everyone realize they've been seeking the murderer in the wrong place.

videos.title: Presumed Dead
videos.overview: While investigating the link between Nicandro and Dr. Alanís, Álex uncovers a key suspect. Rodolfo asks Álex to help him bring his father to justice.

videos.title: Medusa Complex
videos.overview: Sara tells Nicandro's dad about his son's drug business. Reinaldo offers Marifer a deal. Álex secures protection for Chema. Nicandro visits Daniela.

videos.title: Dead or Alive
videos.overview: Lucía's arrival takes Álex's investigation in another direction. A new lawyer takes Chema's case. César shows up at Álex's house to reclaim his money.

videos.title: Welcome to the Medusa Center
videos.overview: Álex fights for his life in the hospital. A distressed Chema asks his mom for help. A flashback shows how Sara became the focus of Reinaldo's experiment.

videos.title: Lab Rats
videos.overview: Worried about her treatment, Sara attempts to expose Reinaldo. Chema is admitted to the Medusa Center. César reveals crucial information to Álex.

videos.title: What Happened to Sara
videos.overview: César pays a visit to Tonya and resorts to a drastic method to get information about Sara. Under Reinaldo's watch, Chema undergoes horrifying treatment.

videos.title: What Did You Do, Sara?
videos.overview: When the truth of what happened to Sara is finally exposed, Álex unleashes one last act of revenge on the Medusa Center.
